2144.name: CALIBER CHEER TRYOUTS 2026 (5 yrs - 18 yrs) - May 11th - May 14th
2144.description:
All Star Cheer Tryouts - May 11th - May 14th

At Caliber, our tryout process is designed to evaluate each athlete’s current skills, athletic ability, and readiness, while ensuring every athlete is placed on the team where they will be the most successful and continue to grow. Everyone who attends tryouts will be placed on a team.

Tryouts will take place in three steps:

Step 1: Individual Skill Evaluation (Tryout Day – approx. 30 minutes)

Athletes will attend a short individual evaluation where coaches will assess:

  • Tumbling skills
  • Jumps and motions
  • Overall athletic ability and technique

Step 2: Stunting Position Assessment & Workout Groups (Week of the 18th)

Athletes will be placed into workout groups to help coaches evaluate:

  • Stunting positions (flyer, base, back spot)
  • Strength, flexibility, and body control
  • Coachability, teamwork, and work ethic

Step 3: Continued Workout Groups & Final Evaluation (Week of the 25th)

Workout groups will continue to allow coaches to evaluate consistency, growth, and athlete readiness. This step helps ensure proper team placement for long-term athlete success.

Team Placements

Every athlete will be placed on a team. Placement decisions are based on:

  • Current skill level
  • Strength and stunting position
  • Maturity and coachability
  • Growth potential
  • Team needs
  • Ability to contribute to a successful and positive season

Our goal is to place every athlete where they will be challenged, supported, and able to thrive both individually and as part of a team.

2101.name: After Care School's Out - Spring Break Camp| Ages 4+ | March 16th-20th | 3:00 PM - 5:30 PM
2101.description:
School's Out - Spring Break Camp

Date & Time: March 16th-20th | 9AM- 3PM

  • Complementary 8:30 AM Early Drop Off.
  •  After Care: 3PM-5:30 PM for $20/day or $100/week (Please Sign Up Separately).

Ages: 4+

Price: $60 Per Day or $240.00 For Full Week (Monday-Friday) 

School's out and camp is in! Learn gymnastics skills, play exciting games, and make new friends at our Girls Gymnastics Camps. Campers will participate in structured rotations on vault, bars, beam, and floor, as well as open gym, crafts, and group activities with our skilled staff. No experience is required to join the fun.

Camp Details:
  • Camp is Non-refundable.
  • Bring a lunch from home.
  • Campers will be separated into groups based on age and ability.
  • Gymnastics campers should wear a leotard or tight-fitting shirt that covers their belly, and shorts or leggings.
  • Must bring water bottle – labeled with the camper’s name on it.
  • Must pre-register & pre-pay.

What to Wear: Students should wear a fitted leotard or athletic clothing that allows for easy movement, with hair securely tied back. All shoes are to be removed before entering the gym and stored in designated cubbies. For safety and to prevent lost items, please limit wearing jewelry during class.

What to Bring: Students should bring a labeled water bottle to each class to stay hydrated. All other personal items, such as bags or extra clothing, should be kept in a designated cubby during class. Please leave toys, electronics, and valuables at home to avoid distractions and prevent lost or damaged items.
